title: Audience-Specific Rewrite
purpose: Adapt writing for two different audiences.
template:
/rewrite /human
Rewrite [[SOURCE_TEXT]] for [[AUDIENCE_A]] and [[AUDIENCE_B]]. Preserve [[NON_NEGOTIABLE_FACTS]]. Give two ready-to-use versions and explain their differences.
example: Rewrite an internship announcement for students and faculty.

title: Evidence-Aware Academic Paragraph
purpose: Produce cautious academic prose supported by evidence.
template:
/academic /professional /verify
Convert [[RESEARCH_NOTES]] into a [[WORD_COUNT]]-word paragraph. Distinguish evidence from interpretation; identify unsupported claims and citation gaps.
example: Write 180 words on TFLite inference performance.

title: Narrative Repair
purpose: Fix chronology and motivation in a story.
template:
/editor /storyteller
Audit [[STORY]] for timeline errors, character motives, and unresolved plot threads. Provide a repair plan and a revised [[TARGET_SCENE]].
example: Repair a reincarnation story where the hero loses his memory.

title: Tone Calibration
purpose: Align a message with its relationship and stakes.
template:
/tone /polish
Rewrite [[MESSAGE]] for [[RECIPIENT_RELATIONSHIP]] using a [[DESIRED_TONE]] tone. Preserve dates, boundaries, and core requests; avoid [[UNWANTED_WORDING]].
example: Make a supervisor follow-up respectful but firm.

title: Technical Documentation from Code
purpose: Document code grounded in actual behavior.
template:
/professional /teacher
Examine [[CODE_OR_API]] and document setup, dependencies, inputs, outputs, error paths, usage examples, and unverified assumptions.
example: Document a Streamlit prediction module.

title: Multi-Channel Content Adaptation
purpose: Tailor one message for multiple platforms.
template:
/copywriter /content
Adapt [[SOURCE_MATERIAL]] into original posts for [[PLATFORMS]], preserving [[KEY_MESSAGE]] while adjusting hooks, length, and calls to action.
example: Adapt a product launch for LinkedIn, Instagram and email.

title: Human-Centered Research Abstract
template:
/human /research /editor
Write a structured abstract using [[OBJECTIVE]], [[METHOD]], [[DATASET]], [[VERIFIED_RESULTS]], and [[LIMITATIONS]]. Do not fabricate metrics.
example: Write an OCTO abstract using measured results.

title: Argument Strengthening
purpose: Make an argument sound and appropriately qualified.
template:
/logic /critic /rewrite
Critique [[ARGUMENT]] for hidden premises and weak evidence. Address counterarguments and revise the conclusion without exaggerating it.
example: Improve an essay advocating edge AI for agriculture.

title: Bilingual Meaning Preservation
template:
/professional /simplify
Translate [[SOURCE_TEXT]] from [[SOURCE_LANGUAGE]] to [[TARGET_LANGUAGE]]. Preserve names, numbers, intent, and register. Explain ambiguous phrases.
example: Translate a German course notice into English.

title: Document Consistency Audit
template:
/proofread /editor
Review [[DOCUMENT]] for inconsistent terminology, headings, abbreviations, tense, and formatting. Provide a correction table followed by the revised text.
example: Standardize terminology throughout an IEEE paper.

title: Research Gap Matrix
purpose: Identify meaningful gaps across multiple papers.
template:
/research /analyst
Analyze [[LITERATURE]] on [[TOPIC]]. Build a matrix of methods, datasets, results, limitations, and open gaps. Attach source citations.
example: Find gaps in explainable plant disease detection.

title: Claim Provenance Tracker
template:
/factcheck /verify
Inspect [[REPORT]]. For each important claim, record source, date, evidence quality, and verification status. Highlight unsupported statements.
example: Audit accuracy claims in a model comparison.

title: Reproducibility Protocol
template:
/research /stepbystep
Design reproducibility steps for [[EXPERIMENT]] covering environment, dataset split, seeds, preprocessing, metrics, and artifact logs.
example: Reproduce a Random Forest versus XGBoost study.

title: Dataset Suitability Review
template:
/analyst /risks
Evaluate [[DATASET]] for [[RESEARCH_GOAL]]. Review labels, licensing, leakage, distribution shifts, class balance, and missing metadata; recommend mitigation tests.
example: Assess PlantVillage for real-world deployment research.

title: Competing Hypotheses
template:
/research /devilsadvocate
Create [[COUNT]] competing hypotheses for [[OBSERVATION]]. Give predictions, confounding factors, and tests that could falsify each.
example: Investigate poor performance on mobile camera images.

title: Paper-to-Implementation Map
purpose: Convert a paper into actionable engineering tasks.
template:
/research /framework
Map [[PAPER_METHOD]] to modules, inputs, outputs, implementation tasks, tests, dependencies, and missing technical details. Do not invent methods.
example: Implement SHAP explanations from a paper.

title: Evidence Update Review
purpose: Update conclusions when new sources appear.
template:
/research /verify
Compare [[NEW_EVIDENCE]] against [[PRIOR_CONCLUSION]]. Classify results as confirming, contradicting, or inconclusive, with citations and proposed revisions.
example: Review a 2024 edge-AI claim using newer studies.

title: Peer Review Simulator
template:
/critic /expert
Review [[MANUSCRIPT]] for novelty, method validity, reproducibility, ethics, statistics, and clarity. Rank major/minor revision requests.
example: Critique an M.Tech paper before IEEE submission.

title: Weighted Decision Matrix
template:
/compare /matrix /analyst
Evaluate [[OPTIONS]] using [[CRITERIA_AND_WEIGHTS]]. Explain scores, perform a sensitivity check, and recommend a choice.
example: Compare Streamlit, FastAPI, and Django.

title: Root-Cause Investigation
template:
/rootcause /logic
Investigate [[PROBLEM]] using [[LOGS_AND_METRICS]]. Build a causal hypothesis tree, identify missing evidence, and rank diagnostic tests.
example: Investigate Render service restarts.

title: Scenario Stress Test
template:
/strategy /risks
Stress-test [[PLAN]] across optimistic, baseline, and adverse scenarios. State assumptions, breakpoints, mitigations, and early-warning signals.
example: Stress-test a startup launch schedule.

title: Metric Integrity Audit
template:
/analyst /verify
Audit [[METRICS]] for definitions, denominator errors, sampling bias, information leakage, uncertainty, and misleading comparisons.
example: Review a multiclass classifier evaluation.

title: Tradeoff Frontier
template:
/compare /optimize
Compare [[ALTERNATIVES]] under [[OBJECTIVES]] and [[CONSTRAINTS]]. Identify dominated options and explain useful tradeoffs.
example: Balance TFLite latency against accuracy.

title: Assumption Register
template:
/assumptions /risks
Extract assumptions from [[PROPOSAL]]. Score confidence, impact, validation cost, and consequences if false; prioritize testing.
example: Audit a study-planner product proposal.

title: Decision Postmortem
template:
/analyst /rootcause
Review [[DECISION]], [[KNOWN_INFORMATION_AT_THE_TIME]], and [[OUTCOME]]. Separate process quality from luck; propose new decision rules.
example: Analyze why a deployment plan failed.

title: Signal Versus Noise Review
template:
/analyst /factcheck
Examine [[TIME_SERIES]] for trend, seasonality, outliers, and sampling effects. Identify high-confidence signals and uncertainty.
example: Analyze uneven weekly app traffic.

title: Regression-Safe Refactor
purpose: Refactor code without unwanted behavior changes.
template:
/debug /optimize
Refactor [[MODULE]] toward [[GOAL]]. Write behavior invariants, characterization tests, minimal changes, and rollback instructions.
example: Refactor OCTO scoring without changing results.

title: API Contract Test Generator
purpose: Generate validation for an API contract.
template:
/dev /template
Write contract tests for [[API_SPEC]] covering valid inputs, invalid inputs, auth, schemas, versioning, and errors.
example: Test a FastAPI prediction endpoint.

title: Cross-Platform Parity Audit
template:
/compare /debug
Review [[WEB_APP]] and [[MOBILE_APP]] for feature, validation, data, and accessibility parity; prioritize fixes.
example: Audit OCTO web and Android versions.

title: Performance Budget Planner
template:
/optimize /analyst
Define budgets for [[APPLICATION]] across latency, memory, CPU, storage and network. Include benchmarks and thresholds.
example: Budget resources for TFLite inference.

title: Dependency Upgrade Safety Plan
template:
/debug /risks
Inspect [[DEPENDENCIES]] and [[TARGET_VERSIONS]]. Identify breaking changes, compatibility tests, staged rollout, and rollback.
example: Plan a TensorFlow/NumPy upgrade.

title: Secure Feature Threat Model
template:
/expert /risks
Threat-model [[FEATURE]] with trust boundaries, assets, attacker goals, misuse paths, mitigations and security tests.
example: Assess document uploads in a research app.

title: CI Failure Triage
template:
/debug /rootcause
Analyze [[CI_LOGS]], [[RECENT_CHANGES]] and [[ENVIRONMENT]]. Rank causes, provide verification commands, and suggest the smallest safe fix.
example: Resolve a Linux-only GitHub Actions failure.

title: Feature-to-Test Traceability
template:
/framework /checklist
Map [[FEATURE_REQUIREMENTS]] to unit, integration, end-to-end, accessibility and edge-case tests. Show coverage gaps.
example: Test a multipage Streamlit survey.

title: Customer Interview Blueprint
template:
/business /research
Create a [[DURATION]]-minute interview for [[SEGMENT]]. Ask about past behavior and jobs-to-be-done; avoid leading questions.
example: Interview students about exam-note challenges.

title: Value Proposition Experiment
template:
/startup /strategy
Design low-cost tests of [[VALUE_PROPOSITION]] for [[AUDIENCE]]. Define hypotheses, conversion metrics, sample limits and stop conditions.
example: Validate an Indian recipe discovery app.

title: Pricing Boundary Analysis
template:
/pricing /analyst
Analyze [[COSTS]], [[CUSTOMER_WILLINGNESS_TO_PAY]], and [[COMPETITOR_DATA]]. Estimate margins, break-even and pricing sensitivity.
example: Price an AI writing assistant.

title: Launch Readiness Gate
template:
/business /checklist
Assess [[PRODUCT]] for reliability, security, support, documentation, compliance and marketing. Define must-fix blockers and release gate.
example: Evaluate an Android release.

title: Customer Journey Friction Audit
template:
/funnel /rootcause
Map [[CUSTOMER_JOURNEY]], identify friction, needed data and measurable improvement tests across acquisition and retention.
example: Audit OCTO sign-up and onboarding.

title: Competitive Positioning Map
template:
/market /compare
Compare [[PRODUCT]] versus [[COMPETITORS]] by audience, features, price, evidence and weaknesses; write a defensible positioning statement.
example: Differentiate an Indian recipe app.

title: Creator Content Portfolio
template:
/content /growth
Build [[POST_COUNT]] posts for [[CREATOR_BRAND]] across education, entertainment, community and promotion, with formats, hooks and success signals.
example: Plan 20 Aryan Singh Studio posts.

title: Partnership Evaluation
template:
/strategy /risks
Evaluate [[PARTNERSHIP]] for audience overlap, mutual value, cost, obligations, risk, and exit provisions. Prioritize negotiating points.
example: Review a local brand collaboration.

title: Weekly Capacity Planner
template:
/productivity /calendar
Plan [[PROJECTS]] around [[AVAILABLE_HOURS]], [[DEADLINES]] and [[ENERGY_LIMITS]]. Add buffer time and priority rules.
example: Balance coursework, coding and content.

title: Workflow Bottleneck Detector
template:
/optimize /rootcause
Map [[WORKFLOW]] by step duration, frequency, dependencies, and error rate; rank improvement opportunities by impact and effort.
example: Optimize PDF-to-exam-notes processing.

title: Automation Safety Specification
template:
/automate /framework
Specify triggers, permissions, input validation, human approval, logging, retry logic, rollback and monitoring for [[AUTOMATION_TASK]].
example: Design a safe Gemini library sync.

title: Knowledge Base Deduplication
template:
/organize /summarize
Compare [[DOCUMENTS]] for duplication, contradiction, staleness and unique insights. Produce a clean index with provenance.
example: Merge overlapping research notes.

title: Study Retrieval Schedule
template:
/teacher /flashcards
Plan review sessions for [[TOPICS]] before [[EXAM_DATE]] using recall, practice problems, spacing and weak-topic reviews.
example: Prepare for an ML exam over 14 days.

title: Meeting-to-Execution Converter
template:
/summarize /checklist
Extract decisions, owners, actions, deadlines, dependencies, and open questions from [[MEETING_NOTES]]. Do not invent commitments.
example: Extract sprint tasks from a project call.

title: Personal Workflow Dashboard
template:
/framework /analyst
Design a dashboard for [[PROJECTS]] using status, next action, due date, blocker, effort, and outcome metrics, plus update rules.
example: Track assignments, papers and GitHub work.

title: Multi-Agent Task Handoff
template:
/automate /promptengineer
Build a handoff from [[AGENT_A_TASK]] to [[AGENT_B_TASK]] specifying structured inputs/outputs, validation, errors, and human approvals.
example: Use Gemini for extraction and ChatGPT for editing.
